data.narrative:
ANYbotics is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $150M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on two methods triangulated against a peer universe of four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B Series B), Dexterity ($1.6B Series B), Hadrian ($1.6B Series C), and Nimble Robotics ($1.0B Series C).

The stage-progression method applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement to the $150M raised proxy, implying a valuation of $285M. The peer-median approach uses the four robotics comparables, which show a median valuation of $1.6B with a range spanning $1.0B to $1.8B. These two methods produce materially different outputs, reflecting the wide dispersion in Series B/C robotics valuations observed across the peer set.

Triangulating both methods yields a low of $242M, median of $955M, and high of $1.9B. The median estimate of $955M sits between the two method outputs but substantially below the peer median, suggesting ANYbotics may trade at a discount to current peer valuations in this stage and sector. Key uncertainties include ANYbotics' revenue scale and growth relative to named peers, product-market fit validation, and the timing and expected terms of its next fundraise, all of which would materially affect placement within the derived range.
